title: Additives our record says the US FDA does not permit
standfirst: What one place does not permit, another may. Here is what the US FDA does not allow in food.
intro: Every additive named here is one our registry records as not permitted in food by the US FDA. That is a decision about the substance itself. It is not a claim about any food you are holding.
A decision like this one is about whether a substance may be used in food at all, in the place that decided. It is not a ceiling on how much of it a food may contain.
sections: The ones our record says the US FDA does not permit
